product: Asian Paints Apex Ultima Exterior Emulsion
description: Apex Ultima is Asian Paints' premium exterior wall finish with 9-year performance warranty. Features SmartGuard+ technology for superior resistance against algae, fungi, and water damage. Contains silicon-enrichced binders for extreme weather durability.
price_reasoning: Asian Paints official site ₹4,200 (MRP), local dealer ₹3,780 (10% discount on 10+ buckets), Amazon ₹4,050 (prime discount). Used MRP.
manufacturer_info: Asian Paints Ltd., India's largest and Asia's third largest paint company. Founded 1942, HQ Mumbai. 27 paint manufacturing facilities globally.
pros: Market leader with strongest brand recall
Excellent color consistency batch to batch
cons: Color range limited for deep/dark shades in exterior
